# Copilot instructions — FlightMode

FlightMode is an offline-first Expo / React Native app (Expo 57, RN 0.86, React 19 with the React Compiler, Expo Router, Zustand 5) for airplane passengers: 47 games, kids mode, a world quiz, relax audio and offline travel tools. The full architecture reference is `CLAUDE.md` in the repo root; it wins when this file and the code disagree.

## Code review checklist (check every PR against these)

1. **Offline first.** Core features must work in airplane mode. Network calls are optional, honour the Online Sync policy (`syncNetworkPolicy`) and never block gameplay or saving.
2. **Analytics privacy.** `captureAnalyticsEvent` payloads must never contain personal data, exact location, flight numbers, dates of a user's flight, free text or quiz question text. Flag any new field that could.
3. **Kids mode.** Kid game variants (`games/<id>/kids.tsx`) and anything reachable from `/kids` must never call `updateProgress` / `recordMatch`, show purchases, links, articles or analytics. Adult game files must stay unchanged by kids work. Route lock lives in `utils/kidsMode.ts`.
4. **Persistence.** Persisted stores use `safePersistOptions` (no writes before hydration). Renaming store keys, game ids or achievement ids orphans user data; a store shape change needs a migration.
5. **Games.** Size from `useGameDimensions()`, never `useWindowDimensions`/`Dimensions`. Timers derive from `Date.now()` deadlines, not chained `setTimeout` ticks. No value read right after `setX(prev => …)` (React 19 runs updaters lazily). Results recorded exactly once.
6. **i18n.** Every new user-facing string exists in all 12 locale files (`i18n/locales/*.ts`); no hard-coded English in UI; plurals via `tn()`.
7. **Monetization.** Never gate anything that is free today; Plus only adds extras.
8. **Secrets.** No API keys, tokens or credentials in code or config; the flight-lookup key is a Cloudflare Worker secret.
9. **Release lanes.** Changes to `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `app.json`, `eas.json`, `plugins/**`, `modules/**`, babel/metro config trigger a native build + Play draft on merge; everything else ships as an OTA update. Call this out when a PR changes those files. `CHANGELOG.md` `Unreleased` is the OTA message — user-facing changes need an entry.
10. **Generated data.** `data/worldQuiz/*.json` and `content/quiz/**` are generated by `scripts/build-quiz-data.mjs`; flag hand edits.
11. **Tests.** New logic needs Jest tests in `__tests__/`; UI flows that matter have Playwright specs in `e2e/` (selectors use accessibility labels — renaming a label breaks them).

Known debt that is NOT a review finding unless the PR makes it worse: hook dependency warnings, index keys in static lists, cognitive-complexity warnings in game loops, `any` in `useAudioStore`.

## Quality gate (CI)

`npx tsc --noEmit`, `npx biome ci .` (Ultracite strict preset; errors fail), `npm test` (Jest), `npm run e2e` (Playwright on the web export), CodeQL and dependency review. Keep them green.

## Where things live

- Game registry: `data/games.ts` (single source of truth). Kids games: `data/kidsGames.ts`.
- Stores: `store/*` (Zustand + AsyncStorage / file storage for large data).
- Theme tokens: `constants/Colors.ts`, `constants/Spacing.ts`, `constants/Typography.ts` — reuse tokens, no raw colours.
- Shared game UI: `components/GameResult.tsx`, `GameControls`, `GamePauseOverlay`, `GameCountdown`, `components/multiplayer/*`.
- Docs to update with behaviour changes: `CHANGELOG.md`, `documents/app-status-and-changelog.md`, `documents/todo-and-improvements.md`.
